summary.text: Teri Mai is an attorney and the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Todd Warner.
She also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Teri Mai was born and raised in Texas.
She earned a bachelor's degree from St. Edward's University in 1993 and a law degree from the Florida Coastal School of Law in 2014.
Her career has included work in the complex litigation group at Morgan & Morgan, P.A., and, earlier, 25 years as a legal assistant.
Mai was the Democratic candidate for District 92 in 2024, when Todd Warner defeated her in the general election, 74.5% to 25.5%.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Democrat who put herself through college while working full-time and raising her daughter, and who went to law school at age 55.
She said she is running to make Tennessee a more family-friendly and affordable place to live.
